meta.name: perf-theory-gatherer
meta.description: Use when generating performance hypotheses backed by git history and code evidence.

copy.tagline: 根据代码历史生成性能优化假设
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码库中定位性能瓶颈并验证优化方向。
copy.tagline_en: Generate performance hypotheses from git history and code evidence
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to identify performance bottlenecks and validate optimization directions in your codebase.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会分析指定场景的性能表现，通过查看 Git 历史和相关代码路径，生成最多 5 条性能假设，每条假设附带证据和置信度。
howto.when: 当你要求分析某个代码场景的性能瓶颈或生成性能假设时触发。

say.text: 分析用户登录模块的性能瓶颈。
say.note: Claude 会查看 Git 历史和相关代码，生成假设。

say.text: 生成关于数据库查询的性能假设。
say.note: Claude 会聚焦数据库相关代码路径。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes performance for a given scenario by reviewing git history and code paths, producing up to 5 hypotheses with evidence and confidence levels.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze performance bottlenecks or generate performance hypotheses for a specific scenario.

say_en.text: Analyze performance bottlenecks in the user login module.
say_en.note: Claude will review git history and code to generate hypotheses.

say_en.text: Generate performance hypotheses for database queries.
say_en.note: Claude will focus on database-related code paths.
